articles.summary: ALEXANDRIA, La. , Dec. 18, 2025 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Red River Bancshares, Inc. (Nasdaq: RRBI) (the “Company”) announced today that its board of directors approved the renewal and increase of its stock repurchase program, which will expire on December 31, 2025 .
articles.title: Red River Bancshares, Inc. Announces Renewal and Increase of Stock Repurchase Program
